name: Delhi
notes: Zones are named localities ~8-12 km apart, matching the ~9 km resolution of the forecast models. They are not MCD wards.

Tier thresholds follow IMD heatwave criteria for the plains (max >= 40 C considered; heatwave >= 45 C; severe heatwave >= 47 C). Delhi's HAP uses IMD colour-coded warnings; replace these with IMD's issued colour where available.
The hot-night threshold is illustrative and should be set by the city.

actions.text: Set up drinking-water points at labour chowks and construction sites in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Delhi HAP: drinking water at public places and worksites

actions.text: Enforce a paid work break at construction sites in {zone} during {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Delhi LG order of 29 May 2024: paid 12-3 PM break at construction sites

actions.text: Open a cooling centre / shaded rest area in {zone}, {start}-{end}, and publish its location.
actions.ref: Delhi HAP: cooling shelters at hotspots

actions.text: Alert heatstroke units serving {zone}; stock ORS, ice packs and IV fluids before {start}.
actions.ref: Delhi HAP: dedicated heatstroke units in hospitals

actions.text: Deploy a mobile heat-relief unit to labour chowks in {zone}, {start}-{end}.
actions.ref: Delhi HAP 2026: DM order to deploy mobile heat-relief units

reference_event.text: IMD recorded 49.9 C at Mungeshpur and Narela on 28 May 2024 (the 52.9 C reading on 29 May was a sensor error).
